reviewer_type: AI author self-review; no independent reviewer

checks_performed: Read the Arabic and English facts, existing rule, proposal and rationale; check that each language expresses the same decision problem.
For every insufficient_information case, specify both a hypothetical compatible completion and a hypothetical conflicting completion consistent with the given facts.
Check that incomplete but irrelevant metadata in selected conflict/no_conflict cases does not change the outcome.
Check numerical reasoning, time-zone conversions, boundaries, exceptions, actual coverage and the difference between mandatory requirements and preferred targets.
Review the previous dataset's 100 authoring-family topics while authoring to avoid copying their complete situations with only different numbers. Abstract reasoning patterns still overlap.
Distinguish issuer authorization (assumed prechecked) from the content of an operational proposal that may conflict with the supplied rule.

corrections_during_review.issue: The initial Arabic wording could mean the customer sent the renewal notice, while English said it was sent to the customer.
corrections_during_review.resolution: Changed Arabic to explicitly state that the notice was sent to the customer; no label change.

retained_limitations: All labels are AI-proposed. Self-review is not independent ground-truth validation.
Some scenarios explicitly identify missing information and some rules are instructional. Performance can reflect these writing patterns rather than real-world document understanding.
One authoring ID per scenario is an organizational convention, not evidence of 45 independent semantic families. Topics such as time zones, data suppression and preview execution recur.
This development set is intentionally balanced and small; its class frequencies need not match an actual organization.
Paired translations are correlated. Ninety records must not be described as ninety independent scenarios.
No claims about real organizational legality, full-system authorization, retrieval quality, OCR or deployment reliability follow from this dataset.
An unchanged source-code hash verifies no evaluator edit, not compatibility with this dataset. The current loader still requires adaptation.

automated_checks.duplicate_check_limitation: Whitespace/case-normalized full-text comparison only; not a semantic novelty test.
automated_checks.digit_check_limitation: Digit sequences only; written-out numbers and semantics were reviewed manually by the AI author.
automated_checks.arithmetic_check_limitation: Independent spot calculations, not an automated proof of labels or natural-language interpretation.
